        H_out = T.int64()

        by = T.env_thread("blockIdx.y")
        bz = T.env_thread("blockIdx.z")

        TILE_Y = 16

        ho = by * TILE_Y + ty
        n_oc = bz

        oc = n_oc % C_out

        with T.if_scope((n < N) & (oc < C_out) & (ho < H_out) & (wo < W_out)):

            ic_per_group = C_in // groups
            g = oc // oc_per_group

                for ic in T.serial(0, T.min(TILE_IC, C_in - ic_tile)):
                    for kh in T.serial(0, K):
                        for kw in T.serial(0, K):
                            a = T.cast(A_shared[ic, ho + kh, wo + kw], "float32")
                            w = T.cast(W_shared[ic, oc_tile - oc_tile + tx, kh, kw], "float32")
                            acc = acc + a * w
                T.evaluate(T.tvm_thread_allsync("shared"))
            # ----------------------------------------------------------
            # write output
            # ----------------------------------------------------------
            B[n, oc_tile + tx, ho_tile + ho, wo] = T.cast(acc, "float16")
